verdict.rationale: Solid's README says it has full SSR and serverless support, with streaming and progressive hydration to reach interactivity quickly. It lists streaming SSR, Suspense and isomorphic client/server rendering as built-in features, which directly covers streaming server-rendered content before all JavaScript loads. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the streaming API (beyond one-line README claims), and independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming SSR performance.
